subject: Draft mutual action plan and signoff timeline — target close discussion
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Reed <natalie@orchestrate.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft mutual action plan and signoff timeline — target close discussion

Hi Natalie — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) to get alignment on milestones, owners, and a target close window. High level asks below; see the attached MAP workbook for dates by milestone.

Proposed target close: 2027-06-24
Proposed contract signature deadline (to unblock procurement): 2027-06-14

Key milestones (draft):
- Internal POC kickoff (Orchestrate owner: Natalie) — 2027-05-25
- Network & security checklist (Redwood owner: Karthik) — 2027-05-31
- Final SOW & commercial redlines (Redwood legal + Orchestrate legal) — draft by 2027-06-04
- Legal signoff & procurement intake (Orchestrate procurement) — 2027-06-10
- Executive sign & contract signature — by 2027-06-14
- Production cutover & validation — week of 2027-06-21

Dependencies we flagged on the call: SOC2 evidence for security review, IP allowlist/VPC peering details, and a short SOW describing data residency. If we aim for a 6/24 launch, signature by 6/14 gives both teams a runway for ops and planning.

Request: can you confirm the procurement owner's timeline and whether 6/14 works as the signature cutoff? If not, what date does procurement need the signed contract by to meet your board/internal launch?

Attachment: Orchestrate_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft — milestone sheet, owners tab, dependencies tab)

Next step: If this looks ok, I’ll iterate the MAP and get Redwood legal (cc’d) to start preparing the contract template and SOC2 artifacts.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Natalie Reed <natalie@orchestrate.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@orchestrate.ai
Date: 2027-05-18T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft mutual action plan and signoff timeline — target close discussion

Ben — thanks for the clear summary and the MAP. A couple of immediate items from our side:

1) Target close: We actually need to aim earlier because the board signoff window is the week of 6/21 and we want all commercial terms locked before that. Can we target a production-ready close by 2027-06-20 instead? That would mean contract signature no later than 2027-06-12.

2) Procurement: looping in procurement@orchestrate.ai — our procurement lead needs the commercial redlines and a completed procurement intake form by 2027-06-06 to make that 6/12 signature realistic. I’m attaching our intake form for completeness.

3) Security/data residency: one new constraint — a subset of data for the initial integration must reside in EU regions; our legal/security team will want to confirm that Redwood can support EU-hosted processing for specific pipelines.

Action items for Redwood: please confirm (a) SOC2 evidence and the type of artifacts you can provide, (b) whether VPC peering/IP allowlist is supported and a rough scheduling window, and (c) if you can compress the SOW/commercial redline turnaround to meet 6/06 intake.

I’ll wait for the updated MAP — happy to jump on a quick legal/proc call if helpful.

—Natalie
Natalie Reed | VP Product, Orchestrate AI
natalie@orchestrate.ai | +1 (628) 555-0121

Attachment: procurement-intake-form.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Reed <natalie@orchestrate.ai>, procurement@orchestrate.ai
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft mutual action plan and signoff timeline — target close discussion

Thanks Natalie — appreciate the clarity. I’ve updated the MAP to reflect your board window and tightened the commercial timeline. New proposals below and new MAP attached (v2).

Updated targets:
- Target production ready close: 2027-06-20
- Contract signature deadline (to meet board window): 2027-06-12
- Procurement intake completion (Orchestrate): 2027-06-06

Updated milestone highlights (changes bolded in attached):
- SOW & commercial redlines to Redwood legal: 2027-05-28
- Redwood returns redlines + SOW rev: 2027-06-02
- Procurement intake & review complete (Orchestrate): 2027-06-06
- Final legal alignment: 2027-06-09
- Signature: 2027-06-12

Redwood commitments we can make now:
- SOC2 artifacts: we can supply a SOC2 summary and auditor contact within 48 hours and a redacted evidence pack within 3 business days (attachment: SOC2_overview.pdf).
- Contract turnaround: Redwood legal (cc’d: Laura) will aim to provide first-pass redlines within 3 business days of receiving your intake and SOW notes.
- Networking: Karthik, can you confirm VPC peering/IP allowlist lead times?

I’m tagging procurement@orchestrate.ai so they have the updated dates. If everyone is aligned on the 6/12 signature target, I’ll lock the MAP and send a version to both legal teams with highlighted redlines to expedite.

Attachments: Orchestrate_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOC2_overview.pdf

Ben/Natalie/Team — quick note from legal and product-security. We can meet the revised timeline but need to call out a few items we will action immediately: 

1) SOC2 / Evidence: Redwood legal will provide a SOC2 summary (control mapping and auditor contact) today and a redacted evidence bundle by 2027-05-21. That should meet your procurement intake needs. Link to SOC2 summary attached above.

2) Contract redlines: Redwood legal will produce first-pass commercial redlines and a standard SOW template by 2027-06-02 (we can accelerate if Orchestrate provides SOW bullet points by 2027-05-24).

3) Data residency: we can support EU-hosted processing for the flagged pipelines. We’ll need a short tech design and an approved IP allowlist for peering. Karthik, please confirm expected lead time.

4) Networking / peering: Karthik — please confirm if VPC peering setup and IP allowlist can be completed within 5 business days once both sides exchange network manifests. Also please confirm any quota or capacity notes for the pilot that might affect the 6/20 production readiness.

If procurement@orchestrate.ai confirms the 6/06 intake deadline and can send the intake + SOW bullets by then, I’m comfortable with a 6/12 signature target. Otherwise, we’ll need to push signature out and adjust the production date.

Happy to set a 30-minute legal/proc call tomorrow if that helps move the redlines faster.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
